# Appendix · Slash Command Reference

Generated from the command definitions the bot registers with `npm run deploy-commands`. Replies with private data are only visible to the member who used the command.

## /economy

National economy of Kagundi

- `/economy overview`: Latest national economic overview
- `/economy markets`: Current commodity prices with duties and tariffs
- `/economy history`: Earlier economic reports<br>Options: `day` (optional): whole number
- `/economy treasury`: Public finances

## /bank

Your personal bank account

- `/bank balance`: Show your balances (opens an account on first use)
- `/bank transactions`: Your recent transactions<br>Options: `account` (optional): text (Bank, Cash, Credit card); `page` (optional): whole number
- `/bank pay`: Pay a person or a business<br>Options: `amount`: number; `memo`: text; `to_user` (optional): member; `to_business` (optional): text; `source` (optional): text (Bank account, Cash, Credit card (businesses only))
- `/bank withdraw`: Withdraw cash from your bank account<br>Options: `amount`: number
- `/bank deposit`: Deposit cash into your bank account<br>Options: `amount`: number
- `/bank credit`: Your credit score and borrowing conditions

## /work

Clock in for your shift today (one paid shift per economic day)

Options: `job` (optional): text

## /jobs

Jobs in Kagundi

- `/jobs list`: Open job postings and public-sector careers
- `/jobs apply`: Apply for a private-sector job<br>Options: `job`: text; `message` (optional): text
- `/jobs mine`: Your jobs and recent shifts
- `/jobs quit`: Resign from a private-sector job<br>Options: `job`: text

## /business

Register and run a business

- `/business register`: Apply to register a new business (fee charged on approval)<br>Options: `name`: text; `industry`: text (Mining, Timber & Forestry, Tobacco Farming, Cattle & Beef, Transport & Freight, Retail & Consumer Services, Construction, Property Management, Financial Services); `output` (optional): text (Gold (g), Diamonds (ct), Palladium (g), Timber (m³), Tobacco (kg), Beef (kg)); `description` (optional): text
- `/business list`: Directory of registered businesses
- `/business status`: Finances, staff and stock of your business<br>Options: `business`: text
- `/business close`: Close your business permanently (remaining money is paid out)<br>Options: `business`: text; `confirm`: text
- `/business account deposit`: Move your own money into the business (capital)<br>Options: `business`: text; `amount`: number
- `/business account withdraw`: Owner only: pay out profit (state share and distribution tax apply)<br>Options: `business`: text; `amount`: number
- `/business account transactions`: Recent transactions of the business account<br>Options: `business`: text; `page` (optional): whole number
- `/business staff post-job`: Publish a job posting<br>Options: `business`: text; `title`: text; `wage`: number; `positions`: whole number
- `/business staff close-job`: Close a job posting<br>Options: `job`: text
- `/business staff applications`: Pending applications<br>Options: `business`: text
- `/business staff hire`: Accept an application<br>Options: `application`: text
- `/business staff reject`: Reject an application<br>Options: `application`: text
- `/business staff fire`: End someone's employment<br>Options: `business`: text; `user`: member
- `/business staff manager-add`: Owner only: give someone management rights<br>Options: `business`: text; `user`: member
- `/business staff manager-remove`: Owner only: remove a manager<br>Options: `business`: text; `user`: member
- `/business market sell`: Export goods from your stock<br>Options: `business`: text; `commodity`: text (Gold (g), Diamonds (ct), Palladium (g), Timber (m³), Tobacco (kg), Beef (kg)); `quantity`: whole number; `partner`: text (Germany, European Union, China)
- `/business market buy`: Import goods into your stock<br>Options: `business`: text; `commodity`: text (Fuel (L), Food & Essentials (crate), Construction Materials (t)); `quantity`: whole number; `partner`: text (Germany, European Union, China)
- `/business market inventory`: Stock of your business<br>Options: `business`: text

## /invoice

Invoices between businesses, citizens and the state

- `/invoice create`: Bill a customer from your business<br>Options: `business`: text; `amount`: number; `memo`: text; `to_user` (optional): member; `to_business` (optional): text; `to_state` (optional): yes/no; `commodity` (optional): text (Gold (g), Diamonds (ct), Palladium (g), Timber (m³), Tobacco (kg), Beef (kg), Fuel (L), Food & Essentials (crate), Construction Materials (t)); `quantity` (optional): whole number
- `/invoice list`: Open invoices you have to pay or have issued
- `/invoice pay`: Pay an invoice<br>Options: `invoice`: text
- `/invoice cancel`: Cancel an open invoice (issuer or recipient)<br>Options: `invoice`: text

## /loan

Loans from the state bank

- `/loan check`: Check whether you would get a loan, without applying<br>Options: `amount`: number; `weeks`: whole number
- `/loan apply`: Apply for a loan (small loans are paid out at once)<br>Options: `amount`: number; `weeks`: whole number; `purpose`: text; `business` (optional): text
- `/loan list`: Your loans and credit card
- `/loan repay`: Repay early (any amount)<br>Options: `loan`: text; `amount`: number

## /card

Your credit card

- `/card apply`: Apply for a credit card (limit depends on credit score and income)
- `/card status`: Limit, amount owed and minimum payment
- `/card pay`: Pay off your card balance<br>Options: `amount`: number

## /insurance

AVK - Allgemeine Volksversicherung Kagundi

- `/insurance products`: AVK products and prices
- `/insurance quote`: Daily premium for a product<br>Options: `product`: text (Vehicle Insurance, Property Insurance, Business Insurance, Liability Coverage, Accident Insurance, Supplementary Health (private treatment only)); `value` (optional): number
- `/insurance buy`: Take out a policy (first day charged now, then daily)<br>Options: `product`: text (Vehicle Insurance, Property Insurance, Business Insurance, Liability Coverage, Accident Insurance, Supplementary Health (private treatment only)); `value` (optional): number; `vehicle` (optional): text; `property` (optional): text; `business` (optional): text
- `/insurance policies`: Your active policies
- `/insurance cancel`: Cancel a policy<br>Options: `policy`: text
- `/insurance claim`: File a claim (reviewed by an AVK officer)<br>Options: `policy`: text; `amount`: number; `incident`: text; `description`: text; `evidence`: text

## /property

Rent, buy and sell property

- `/property list`: Properties available for rent or sale<br>Options: `city` (optional): text (Gundiville, Stokondo, Kagundali, Oberdueshuson)
- `/property mine`: Properties you own or rent
- `/property rent`: Rent a property (first day of rent paid now)<br>Options: `property`: text; `business` (optional): text
- `/property leave`: End your lease<br>Options: `property`: text
- `/property buy`: Buy a property that is for sale (transfer tax applies)<br>Options: `property`: text; `business` (optional): text
- `/property sell`: Offer your property for sale<br>Options: `property`: text; `price`: number
- `/property unlist`: Withdraw your sale offer<br>Options: `property`: text
- `/property set-rent`: Set the daily rent of a vacant property you own<br>Options: `property`: text; `rent`: number; `for_rent` (optional): yes/no
- `/property create`: Officials: register a new state-owned property<br>Options: `name`: text; `city`: text (Gundiville, Stokondo, Kagundali, Oberdueshuson); `type`: text (residential, commercial, industrial, agricultural); `value`: number; `rent`: number; `for_sale` (optional): yes/no

## /fine

Fines

- `/fine issue`: Police, Gendarmerie and judges: issue a fine<br>Options: `user`: member; `amount`: number; `reason`: text; `case` (optional): text
- `/fine mine`: Your open fines
- `/fine pay`: Pay a fine<br>Options: `fine`: text
- `/fine cancel`: Judges and economic staff: cancel a fine (e.g. after an appeal)<br>Options: `fine`: whole number; `reason`: text

## /treasury

Government: public spending and budgets

- `/treasury spend`: Pay public money (above 25,000.00 KGD a second official must approve)<br>Options: `amount`: number; `category`: text (Government & Administration, Police & Gendarmerie, Defence & Revolutionary Guard, Justice, Healthcare & EMS, Brandwehr & Civil Protection, Education, Infrastructure, Public Services & AVK, Public Procurement, Other Expenditure); `reason`: text; `to_user` (optional): member; `to_business` (optional): text
- `/treasury pay-invoice`: Pay an invoice addressed to the state<br>Options: `invoice`: text; `category`: text (Government & Administration, Police & Gendarmerie, Defence & Revolutionary Guard, Justice, Healthcare & EMS, Brandwehr & Civil Protection, Education, Infrastructure, Public Services & AVK, Public Procurement, Other Expenditure); `reason`: text
- `/treasury pending`: Spending requests waiting for a second approval
- `/treasury approve`: Approve another official's spending request<br>Options: `request`: text
- `/treasury reject`: Reject a spending request<br>Options: `request`: text; `reason`: text
- `/treasury budget`: Budget lines of the current 30-day period
- `/treasury budget-set`: Set a budget line for the current period<br>Options: `category`: text (Government & Administration, Police & Gendarmerie, Defence & Revolutionary Guard, Justice, Healthcare & EMS, Brandwehr & Civil Protection, Education, Infrastructure, Public Services & AVK, Public Procurement, Other Expenditure); `amount`: number; `reason`: text
- `/treasury wage`: Change a public-sector daily wage<br>Options: `department`: text; `wage`: number; `reason`: text

## /policy

Government: taxes, fees, tariffs and the policy rate

- `/policy show`: Current economic policy
- `/policy set`: Change a tax rate, fee or the policy rate (within fixed limits)<br>Options: `setting`: text (Central bank policy rate, Income tax (withheld from wages), Turnover tax on business income, Distribution tax on profit withdrawals, Property tax per year, Property transfer tax, Business registration fee, Minimum daily wage (private sector), Maximum daily wage (private sector), Starting balance for new citizens); `value`: number; `reason`: text
- `/policy tariff`: Import tariff on a commodity<br>Options: `commodity`: text (Fuel (L), Food & Essentials (crate), Construction Materials (t)); `percent`: number; `reason`: text
- `/policy export-duty`: Export duty on a commodity<br>Options: `commodity`: text (Gold (g), Diamonds (ct), Palladium (g), Timber (m³), Tobacco (kg), Beef (kg)); `percent`: number; `reason`: text
- `/policy export-ban`: Ban or allow exports of a commodity<br>Options: `commodity`: text (Gold (g), Diamonds (ct), Palladium (g), Timber (m³), Tobacco (kg), Beef (kg)); `banned`: yes/no; `reason`: text

## /registry

Business registry: review registrations

- `/registry pending`: Applications waiting for a decision
- `/registry approve`: Approve a registration (the fee is charged now)<br>Options: `business`: text; `state_share` (optional): number; `reason` (optional): text
- `/registry reject`: Reject a registration<br>Options: `business`: text; `reason`: text
- `/registry suspend`: Suspend an active business<br>Options: `business`: text; `reason`: text
- `/registry reinstate`: Lift a suspension<br>Options: `business`: text; `reason`: text

## /credit-office

Credit officers: review loan applications

- `/credit-office pending`: Loan applications waiting for a decision
- `/credit-office approve`: Approve a loan (all lending rules are checked again)<br>Options: `loan`: text; `reason`: text
- `/credit-office reject`: Reject a loan application<br>Options: `loan`: text; `reason`: text

## /avk

AVK officers: review insurance claims

- `/avk claims`: Open claims
- `/avk approve`: Approve and pay a claim<br>Options: `claim`: text; `reason`: text; `payout` (optional): number
- `/avk deny`: Deny a claim<br>Options: `claim`: text; `reason`: text

## /central-bank

Central Bank of Kagundi

- `/central-bank status`: Policy rate, money supply and exchange rate
- `/central-bank finance-treasury`: Owner only: emergency money creation for the treasury (raises inflation)<br>Options: `amount`: number; `reason`: text

## /econ-admin

Economic staff tools (all actions are audited)

- `/econ-admin inspect`: Full financial record of a citizen (viewing is audited)<br>Options: `user`: member; `reason`: text
- `/econ-admin adjust`: Correct a verified error (above 10,000.00 KGD Owner only)<br>Options: `direction`: text (Add, Remove); `amount`: number; `reason`: text; `user` (optional): member; `business` (optional): text
- `/econ-admin freeze`: Freeze accounts (stops voluntary payments; obligations still run)<br>Options: `reason`: text; `user` (optional): member; `business` (optional): text
- `/econ-admin unfreeze`: Unfreeze accounts<br>Options: `reason`: text; `user` (optional): member; `business` (optional): text
- `/econ-admin events`: Active economic events and the event catalogue
- `/econ-admin event-start`: Start an economic event from the catalogue (from tomorrow)<br>Options: `event`: text; `reason`: text; `days` (optional): whole number
- `/econ-admin event-end`: End an event early (from today)<br>Options: `id`: whole number; `reason`: text
- `/econ-admin maintenance`: Owner only: pause all economy actions of players<br>Options: `on`: yes/no; `reason`: text
- `/econ-admin tick-status`: Daily processing status, failures and integrity check
- `/econ-admin tick-run`: Process any finished economic days now (safe to repeat)
- `/econ-admin backup`: Write a database backup now
- `/econ-admin audit`: Recent audit log entries<br>Options: `actor` (optional): member

## /roster

Department leaders: manage the members of your department

- `/roster add`: Give a department or office role<br>Options: `user`: member; `role`: text; `note` (optional): text
- `/roster remove`: Remove a department or office role<br>Options: `user`: member; `role`: text; `note` (optional): text
- `/roster list`: Members of a role you manage<br>Options: `role`: text

## /panel

Administrators: post a button panel in its channel

Options: `panel`: text (Verification (#verify), Civilian role (#start-here), Support tickets (#support), Player reports (#player-reports), Appeals (#appeals), Faction applications (#faction-applications), Business registry (#business-registration), Legal services (#legal-information), All panels)

## /mod

Moderators: verification and restrictions

- `/mod verify`: Verify a member by hand (e.g. account younger than the minimum age)<br>Options: `user`: member; `reason`: text
- `/mod restrict`: Restrict a member: removes all member and department roles until lifted<br>Options: `user`: member; `reason`: text
- `/mod unrestrict`: Lift a restriction and restore the previous roles<br>Options: `user`: member; `reason`: text
